I don't just create designs. I engineer visual solutions that lift a brand's prestige and drive conversion.

Hi, I'm Ahmed.

I'm a senior graphic designer based in Cairo, with more than five years across branding, social media, product design and illustration. Most of my work is in real estate and corporate design, where a layout has to feel as exact as a floor plan and still make someone want to live there.

I started freelancing in 2019, while studying Philosophy at Cairo University, and graduated in 2022. Since then I've delivered branding, logos and social visuals for clients across different industries, worked on furniture rebrands at Golden Hands, and today I'm a senior designer at TGD, a real estate developer.

I turn complex business goals into campaigns that build brand prestige and drive enquiries. AI tools sit inside my workflow next to the fundamentals, and I edit video and motion in Premiere Pro, After Effects and CapCut, so a campaign can move from a static layout to a finished video.

Away from client briefs I run a personal art gallery, open since 2020, where I draw in more than five styles including scribble, realism, stippling and vector art. The dots across this page are a nod to the stippling. Visit the gallery on Instagram
